summary: A Quote subscription survives the broker dropping the socket: the feed logs in again, subscribes the touchline again, and the snapshot Noren answers with is served.

notes: The desktop drops its cached snapshots on a new connection (appendix item 11); the web's TradeSmart adapter keeps them. A full snapshot follows every subscribe, so both serve the same frame here.

deviations.reason: The web's TradeSmart adapter forwards Noren's trade time ltt (HH:MM:SS, null when the frame has none) as last_trade_time; the desktop's carrier has no place for it.

The desktop sends Noren's feed time ft, in ms, as ltt: a packet time, not the trade time. Noren's trade time is its ltt (HH:MM:SS, IST), which the web forwards raw as last_trade_time; the web's TradeSmart adapter sends no ltt key in any mode, LTP included. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).

The web's TradeSmart adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full) for every broker. Closed in phase B by the per-broker dialect switch (lane wire), set to what this adapter does (lead rule 2026-11-09).
The stream carries no OI for this instrument (a cash equity or an index); the web's TradeSmart adapter sends oi 0, the desktop leaves it out (web openalgo#2376).
The web's TradeSmart adapter forwards Noren's pc as percent_change for every instrument; the desktop sends the change fields for indices only.
The web forwards Noren's feed time ft (epoch seconds) as tradesmart_timestamp; the desktop drops it.
